faqs.q: My dog is between 6 and 12 months, pulls on the lead and ignores recall. Does the Junior course cover that?
faqs.a: Junior is for puppies of 6 to 12 months and it works on recall — being responsive to their name and coming back when called — and on engagement training with touch or a clicker, which Gaynor describes as invaluable as you progress to getting your dog to walk on the lead without pulling. "Follow me" teaches your puppy to stay close and look at you, and that is the foundation for both loose-lead walking and coming back when called. The six weeks also cover sit, down and stand, a stay working towards 30 seconds, not jumping up, and examining your pup for the vet. Loose-lead heel work on the lead is then Bronze's main subject, for dogs of 12 months and upward.
